title: review_decisions.json
description: Since 1.6. A teacher's decisions on HUMAN_REVIEW edges of validated_graph.json, one row per edge (a new decision replaces the old one). Written by website page 3 through cdlp/validation/apply_review.py, which applies them to validated_graph.json.

edge_id.description: id of the edge in validated_graph.json when decided; edges are matched by (source, target) first, since ids can change when validation is re-run

decided_by.description: who decided: 'teacher' from page 3; 'simulated_teacher' in the review-queue experiment

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 time; decisions are applied in this order

comment.description: optional free-text reason from the teacher
